messages:
Eli (CS): Heads-up — Sparrow renewal in ~6 weeks. Onboarding status: good, but token spend is up 30% MoM. Proactive play: propose quantization + model swap + smart routing to hit latency and cost targets. @Maya can you own the eng run for this? @Rina (Sparrow) any hard constraints?
Maya (Solutions): Yep — can pick this up. Quick Q: what model + current config are they on?
Eli (CS): They're on open-gpt-large-v1 (fp16 hosted). Metrics: avg_seq_len ~420, 95p_latency_ms: 420, avg_tokens_per_request: 280, error_rate low. Cost trending up. Goal: 95p < 300ms, cost -20%.
Maya (Solutions): Recommend creating an int8/qdq variant: open-gpt-medium-qdq. Swap plan: A/B 5-10% traffic for 48h, run quality evals on our baseline prompt set. Expected perf: ~15-25% latency improvement, small accuracy delta. I'll draft runbook.
Rina (Sparrow): Latency target is critical (<300ms). Cannot accept higher hallucination rate. We're open to A/B test. Prefer low-risk windows (weekday mornings PST).
Alex (Eng Runtime): I can provision a canary pool and a variant. Routing policy: 'latency-first' with fallback to current model. Will add automatic rollback if 95p latency or quality degrades >5%. ETA to prepare: 48h.
Eli (CS): I'll log this in the account health notes and flag renewal risk as 'pending mitigation' until results. Also suggest an enablement session for their infra/devs to tune prefix caching and batching params.
Maya (Solutions): Scheduled the enablement/demo: Wed 10:00 AM PT. Draft runbook steps:
```1) Create qdq variant (open-gpt-medium-qdq)
2) Route 5% traffic for 48h (canary)
3) Collect metrics: 95p_latency, p50, cost_per_k_token, quality eval A/B
4) If stable, scale to 25% for 72h
5) Post-mortem & rollback plan
```
Maya (Solutions): I'll attach the eval prompt set + a small script to compute quality deltas.
deploy-bot: Canary created: id=c-7891, variant=open-gpt-medium-qdq, scheduled_start=2026-03-22T15:00:00Z
Rina (Sparrow): Sending our test prompts + a few safety cases now. Finance/team preps renewal notes.
Eli (CS): Great. Thanks everyone — I'll capture feedback after canary and update the renewal playbook. :thumbsup:
